title: WASH and Cholera Preparedness for Campus Organizers
description: Help students and campus organizers understand WASH risk, cholera preparedness, and responsible support without giving medical advice.

steps.title: Start with official public-health sources
steps.purpose: Anchor the session in reviewed public guidance.
steps.task: Read the official guidance and identify three non-medical learning points.

steps.title: Connect WASH to responsible action
steps.purpose: Show how WASH needs relate to safeguards and partner routing.
steps.task: Draft a workshop slide explaining WASH risk without operational details.

steps.title: Prepare a campus action checklist
steps.purpose: Turn learning into responsible support planning.
steps.task: Create questions for a reviewed WASH partner before offering support.

safeguards: This pathway links to official public-health guidance. It does not provide medical advice.
No amateur field deployment or operational infrastructure mapping.
Any project must be requested by accountable partners.

title: Maternal Health and Dignity in Humanitarian Settings
description: Help donors, students, and advocates understand maternal health, reproductive health, dignity, protection, and emergency referral awareness in humanitarian settings.

steps.title: Learn the dignity frame
steps.purpose: Understand why maternal health includes dignity, privacy, protection, and referral awareness.
steps.task: Write five dignity-centered questions for a briefing.

steps.title: Read accountability boundaries
steps.purpose: Keep support routed through accountable services.
steps.task: Identify evidence needed before recommending a support channel.

steps.title: Draft a responsible support note
steps.purpose: Translate concern into careful action.
steps.task: Write a one-page note with caveats and no medical advice.

safeguards: This pathway does not provide medical advice.
Referral and protection pathways require qualified partner review.
Do not collect personal health stories or identify vulnerable people.

title: Child Nutrition and Responsible Support
description: Help users understand malnutrition, food assistance, nutrition screening, and responsible ways to support verified actors.

steps.title: Read the food-security signal
steps.purpose: Separate urgent need from unsupported claims.
steps.task: List the source badges and caveats attached to the food sector.

steps.title: Review support boundaries
steps.purpose: Avoid direct-risk or unreviewed routes.
steps.task: Create a short responsible-giving checklist.

safeguards: No direct distribution outside reviewed organizations.
No direct contact with minors.
Nutrition learning does not replace qualified health or nutrition guidance.

title: Education in Emergencies and Temporary Learning
description: Help teachers, students, and universities understand learning disruption, temporary learning spaces, psychosocial support, teacher recovery, and child safeguarding.

steps.title: Map education as protection
steps.purpose: Understand why learning continuity also supports safety and stability.
steps.task: Create a concept map linking learning, protection, and teacher recovery.

steps.title: Add safeguarding boundaries
steps.purpose: Prevent direct-risk engagement with children.
steps.task: Draft workshop ground rules and referral boundaries.

steps.title: Design a temporary learning support proposal
steps.purpose: Create a partner-reviewed support concept.
steps.task: Prepare a proposal outline for institutional review.

safeguards: No direct unsupervised contact with minors or vulnerable people.
All programs must be partner-mediated and safeguarding-reviewed.
This pathway does not provide therapy or clinical guidance.

title: Trauma-Informed Peacebuilding
description: Help peacebuilders and facilitators understand grief, trauma, safety, dignity, and the limits of dialogue during active crisis.

steps.title: Name trauma-aware boundaries
steps.purpose: Avoid treating dialogue as a cure-all during active crisis.
steps.task: Write a facilitation boundary statement.

steps.title: Connect grief, safety, and dignity
steps.purpose: Build language that does not exploit pain.
steps.task: Create discussion questions that preserve agency.

steps.title: Prepare a reviewed workshop plan
steps.purpose: Convert the lens into accountable practice.
steps.task: Draft an agenda with safety pauses and referral notes.

safeguards: This pathway does not provide therapy or clinical guidance.
Dialogue work must be facilitated by qualified people with safeguards.
Do not extract stories from crisis-affected people.

title: Conflict Transformation for Student Leaders
description: Help student leaders understand conflict transformation, polarization, narrative, mediation, negotiation, and responsible campus action.

steps.title: Study conflict transformation basics
steps.purpose: Move from reaction to disciplined inquiry.
steps.task: Map one campus tension using needs, fears, identities, and safeguards.

steps.title: Prepare sourced public language
steps.purpose: Reduce dehumanization and unsupported claims.
steps.task: Rewrite a public statement using sourced claims and dignity language.

steps.title: Design a campus action lab
steps.purpose: Build a responsible learning event.
steps.task: Create an agenda with speakers, sources, and safety boundaries.

safeguards: Do not use dehumanizing language or unsupported claims.
Dialogue should be skilled, voluntary, and safeguarded.
Campus action should not imply endorsement or certification.

title: Trust Evidence and Responsible Giving
description: Help donors and civic groups understand organization transparency, evidence, sanctions screening, humanitarian accountability, and responsible routing.

steps.title: Read the Trust Evidence Layer
steps.purpose: Understand evidence language without ratings.
steps.task: List the seven Transparency Passport fields.

steps.title: Review source and routing boundaries
steps.purpose: Avoid unsupported action pathways.
steps.task: Create a donor due-diligence checklist.

steps.title: Compare organization profiles
steps.purpose: Practice evidence-based review.
steps.task: Compare two profiles by evidence availability and caveats.

safeguards: No organization rankings, certification, or endorsement claims.
Do not route support to unreviewed organizations.
Compliance and sanctions screening require qualified review.

title: Building Technology Tools Without Causing Harm
description: Help technologists and university labs build responsible tools without exposing sensitive data, vulnerable people, locations, or operational details.

steps.title: Define the harm boundary
steps.purpose: Prevent sensitive data exposure before a prototype is built.
steps.task: Write a no-sensitive-data project brief.

steps.title: Map users and data risks
steps.purpose: Design for privacy and partner governance.
steps.task: Create a data-minimization checklist.

steps.title: Prepare partner review questions
steps.purpose: Keep deployment decisions outside the prototype team.
steps.task: Draft questions for an institutional or humanitarian partner.

safeguards: No sensitive data collection, no location exposure, no beneficiary identification, and no deployment without partner review.
No live AI decisions in aid delivery.
Do not publish tactical operational details.

title: Anticipatory Action and Local Emergency Preparedness
description: Help community leaders, students, and organizations understand how demographics, climate stress, displacement, public health, and access constraints shape emergency preparedness.

steps.title: Read scenarios as assumptions
steps.purpose: Use foresight without treating it as prediction.
steps.task: Write three assumptions and three uncertainties.

steps.title: Identify preparedness capacities
steps.purpose: Connect public health, WASH, displacement, and communication needs.
steps.task: Draft a preparedness checklist for partner review.

steps.title: Plan a partner-mediated learning circle
steps.purpose: Keep community learning safe and accountable.
steps.task: Write facilitation safeguards and review gates.

safeguards: Community learning circles involving crisis-affected people must be partner-mediated, safeguarding-reviewed, and human-approved.
This pathway does not provide medical or security advice.
Use scenarios as assumptions, not predictions.

title: Youth Leadership for Social Cohesion and Future Recovery
description: Help young people and youth-serving organizations build leadership, dialogue, civic capacity, emotional intelligence, cultural intelligence, and practical peacebuilding skills.

steps.title: Define safe youth agency
steps.purpose: Keep youth leadership non-extractive and protected.
steps.task: Write a youth agency statement with safeguarding boundaries.

steps.title: Build social cohesion competencies
steps.purpose: Practice dialogue, cultural humility, and emotional intelligence.
steps.task: Design a session plan for adult-reviewed facilitation.

steps.title: Prepare a partner project outline
steps.purpose: Connect leadership learning to accountable institutions.
steps.task: Create a partner-mediated project proposal.

safeguards: No direct unsupervised contact with minors or vulnerable people.
All programs must be partner-mediated and safeguarding-reviewed.
Youth stories and identities must not be extracted for advocacy.
